guarantees.claim: debug_req_o is asserted only when both debug_req and debug_req_en are high.
When DMI interface is used and DMIDirectTAP is not defined, DMI reset (dmi_rst_n) is directly driven by system reset rst_ni.
In DMI mode (UseDmiInterface), the JTAG output jtag_o is always tied to zero.
In JTAG mode, dmi_en is asserted only when lifecycle controller allows debug DMIs (pinmux_hw_debug_en[PmEnDmiReq] strictly true).
In JTAG mode without DMIDirectTAP, DMI request valid and response ready are gated with dmi_en: dmi_req_valid = dmi_req_valid_raw & dmi_en and dmi_rsp_ready = dmi_rsp_ready_raw & dmi_en.
en_ifetch is MUBI4-encoded from the lifecycle-gated fetch enable: en_ifetch = mubi4_bool_to_mubi(lc_tx_test_true_strict(lc_hw_debug_en_gated[LcEnFetch])).

The tlul_adapter_reg instance i_tlul_adapter_reg is configured with CmdIntgCheck=1, EnableRspIntgGen=1, EnableDataIntgGen=1, enforcing command integrity check and response/data integrity generation on the debug module memory window.

uncertain_points.claim: In JTAG mode, if dmi_en deasserts while dmi_req_valid_raw is high, dmi_req_valid will drop immediately. This may truncate an in-flight DMI request to dm_top, potentially violating the DMI protocol and leaving the system in an undefined state.
uncertain_points.risk: Truncated DMI transfers could cause dm_top state machine deadlock, lost debug commands, or incomplete data writes, possibly resulting in functional failure or security-relevant misbehavior.

uncertain_points.claim: Gating dmi_rsp_ready with dmi_en (dmi_rsp_ready = dmi_rsp_ready_raw & dmi_en) can block the dm_top from completing a response handshake when dmi_en is low, potentially causing a stall in the DMI response channel.

security_implications: Signals debug_req_o, dmi_req_valid, jtag_o, en_ifetch are gated by lifecycle debug enable (lc_hw_debug_en_gated, pinmux_hw_debug_en). Unauthorized assertion of debug enable or failure of the gating logic (e.g., due to lifecycle signal glitch or incorrect encoding) could grant JTAG or DMI access to a powered-on device, exposing secrets in registers/memory or allowing execution injection. The MUBI encoding on en_ifetch provides single-bit fault resistance, but an attacker with physical access could attempt to flip multiple bits; integrity errors (rom_intg_error, dbg_intg_error) generated by the TL-UL adapters may indicate tampering, but if not escalated to an alert, integrity breaches could persist undetected. Additionally, residual DMI FIFO data across debug session re-enable (U3) could leak sensitive information if not cleared.
